name: Washington State Long-Term Care Ombuds Program
organization: Washington State Long-Term Care Ombuds Program (Multi-Service Center)
description: Ombuds advocate for residents of nursing homes, assisted living and adult family homes and help resolve problems with long-term care. Regional ombuds programs serve each area of the state.
next_step: Call 800-562-6028 and give the facility’s county to reach the regional ombuds. For immediate danger, call 911. To report abuse or neglect in a licensed facility, call 800-562-6078.
constraints: The ombuds acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing or enforcement agency.

name: Northwest Justice Project CLEAR hotline
description: Free civil legal advice and referral for people with low income who live outside King County. Not criminal defense.
next_step: Call weekdays 9:15 AM–12:15 PM, or apply online. Interpreters are provided. Facing eviction? Call 855-657-8387.
constraints: Income limits apply (about 125% of the federal poverty level). Legal aid is not guaranteed representation.

name: CLEAR*Sr legal hotline (age 60+)
description: Free civil legal advice for Washington residents age 60 and older, regardless of income.
next_step: Call weekdays starting at 9:15 AM and leave a message with your name and phone number; the line closes when voicemail is full. Low-income seniors can also call CLEAR at 888-201-1014.
constraints: Asset limits may apply. Advice and referral; ongoing representation is not guaranteed.

name: VA medical centers serving Washington
description: VA medical centers serving Washington: VA Puget Sound Health Care System, Seattle (206-762-1010) and American Lake, Tacoma (253-582-8440); Mann-Grandstaff VA Medical Center, Spokane (509-434-7000); and Jonathan M. Wainwright Memorial VA Medical Center, Walla Walla (509-525-5200). Southwest Washington is served by the VA Portland Health Care System, including its Vancouver campus.
next_step: Use VA’s facility locator with your ZIP code to find the closest clinic and its medical center. Not enrolled yet? Call 877-222-8387 or ask your county veterans program or WDVA for help applying.
constraints: VA does not publish county lists for these systems, so this card does not assign counties. Your VA care team may be at a different clinic or system; follow what VA tells you.
